local_instances.message: Found 4 local PowerBI Desktop and Analysis Services instances

results.message: Successfully retrieved measure 'Registrations per Source Record'

data.name: YoY Growth %
data.expression: DIVIDE([Total Registrations] - [Previous Year Registrations], [Previous Year Registrations])

data.name: Top 3 Brand Share %
data.expression: VAR TopBrands = TOPN(3, ALL(DimBrand[Brand]), [Total Registrations], DESC) RETURN DIVIDE(SUMX(TopBrands, [Total Registrations]), CALCULATE([Total Registrations], REMOVEFILTERS(DimBrand)), 0)

data.name: H5 January YoY %
data.expression: VAR Jan2026 = CALCULATE([Total Registrations], REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate), DimDate[Year] = 2026, DimDate[Month] = 1) VAR Jan2025 = CALCULATE([Total Registrations], REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate), DimDate[Year] = 2025, DimDate[Month] = 1) RETURN DIVIDE(Jan2026-Jan2025, Jan2025)

data.name: Selected Model
data.expression: IF(HASONEVALUE(DimSeries[SeriesKey]), CALCULATE(SELECTEDVALUE(ModelComparison[Model]), ModelComparison[SelectedModel] = TRUE()), "Choose exactly one series")

results.message: Successfully retrieved measure 'Test Improvement over Naive %'

data.name: Test Improvement over Naive %
data.expression: DIVIDE([Naive Test MAE]-[Selected Test MAE], [Naive Test MAE])
